blocks.text: The Asia Forum on Nicotine (AFN) 2026 opened on October 16 at Astoria Hotel in Ortigas with a call for wider adoption of science-based tobacco harm reduction (THR) and broader access to safer nicotine products across the Asia Pacific. At the center of the forum was the Asia Pacific Declaration, a formal call on health ministers and public health officials across the World Health Organization (WHO) South-East Asia and Western Pacific regions to legalize safer nicotine alternatives for smoking adults. The Declaration outlines the risks posed by combustible cigarettes and high-risk oral tobacco products, advocates risk-proportionate regulation of lower-risk nicotine alternatives, […]...
